overall.headline: Coast still hazardous through Saturday; Iran-linked Gulf attacks, Ukraine and Yemen fighting continue.
overall.bluf: One ACTION today: stay off Pacifica's beaches, pier and shoreline. NWS has extended the Coastal Flood Advisory to 4 PM Saturday (high tides near 12:30 PM Friday and 1:30 PM Saturday) and a Beach Hazards Statement to 7 AM Saturday, with waves of 13 to 19 feet. No FEMA emergency alerts cover Pacifica. Abroad, two Italian technicians died in a drone attack on Kuwait that Iran denies, and Ebola in eastern Congo has reached about 12,000 cases.

local.note: Flood advisory to Sat 4 PM; pier damaged; beaches unsafe.

regional.note: Weak storm Sunday; US storm outages; VIX 25.

world.note: Gulf drone strikes, Ukraine, Yemen, Ebola.

changes: Extended: NWS Coastal Flood Advisory now runs to 4 PM Saturday; Beach Hazards Statement to 7 AM Saturday (13 to 19 ft breaking waves).
Eased: the forecast for next Tuesday and Wednesday trimmed; a weak system Sunday into Monday brings up to a quarter inch of rain to Pacifica (NWS).
Resolved: DreamHost shared-hosting connectivity problem fixed Thursday 10:19 AM; legacy API keys still stopped.
New: Two Italian technicians were killed in a drone attack on Kuwait Thursday; Kuwait and Italy blame Iran, Iran denies it (Al Jazeera).
New: Houthis report 11 killed in an airstrike on a cinema building in Turbah, Taiz, early Friday; they blame Saudi Arabia (unverified).
New: Ebola in eastern Congo reported at 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate (NPR); Kim Jong Un vows more nuclear weapons.
Update: Hundreds of thousands in Pennsylvania and nearby states without power after Thanksgiving storms (BBC).
Dropped as stale: Bangkok refinery blast, Iraq oil-fields ruling, Cairo tanker crash, new tariff proposal details.

coming_up.when: Fri high tide 12:31 PM; Sat 1:28 PM
coming_up.title: King tides with surge: Coastal Flood Advisory to Sat 4 PM
coming_up.detail: Tides 1.6 to 1.7 ft above normal at San Francisco; low spots near Beach Blvd may flood.

coming_up.title: Beach Hazards Statement: sneaker waves, rip currents, 13–19 ft surf
coming_up.detail: Stay out of the water and off jetties, piers and rocks.

coming_up.title: Weak storm: light rain, gusts 25–35 mph
coming_up.detail: Up to about a quarter inch on the Peninsula; more in the North Bay.

coming_up.title: Caltrans one-way traffic on Hwy 1 near Montara and Pescadero
coming_up.detail: Drainage and slide-repair work Nov 30 to Dec 3; expect delays south of Pacifica.

coming_up.title: Second, southerly storm; rain 0.25–0.75 in around the Bay
coming_up.detail: Track may shift; check the forecast Monday.

home_front.summary: Coast hazardous through Saturday; no FEMA alerts.

items.title: Stay off Pacifica's shoreline through Saturday: king tides and 13–19 ft waves
items.detail: NWS extended the Coastal Flood Advisory to 4 PM Saturday and the Beach Hazards Statement to 7 AM Saturday for the San Francisco Peninsula coast. Part of the pier fell into the sea Wednesday, and the rest is closed. No FEMA emergency alerts cover Pacifica.
items.action: Stay off the pier, beaches, jetties, rocks and bluff edges and out of the water; keep children and pets back. Move cars from low spots near the shore before about 12:30 PM Friday and 1:30 PM Saturday; don't drive through water or around barricades.
items.where: Pacifica Pier, Beach Blvd, Rockaway, Sharp Park

home_front.summary: No Pacifica outage found; DreamHost issue resolved.

items.title: DreamHost: connectivity issue resolved; legacy API keys no longer work
items.detail: DreamHost fixed a shared-hosting connectivity problem Thursday 10:19 AM Pacific. Its Wednesday notice still stands: legacy API keys stopped working and phpMyAdmin is unavailable.
items.action: If a script uses the DreamHost API, make a new key in the panel.

home_front.summary: Beach Blvd may flood at high tide; no Caltrans closure in Pacifica.

items.title: Beach Blvd and low coastal roads may flood at high tide midday
items.detail: Waves flooded parts of Beach Blvd Wednesday (KQED). I found no closure notice for Hwy 1 or Beach Blvd this morning; NWS warns some roads may close.
items.action: If water reaches the road, use Sharp Park Rd or Hwy 35 and check QuickMap.

home_front.summary: Air quality moderate (AQI 66); no local advisories.

default.task: Charge phones and power banks and check flashlight batteries.
default.why: Rain and gusts arrive Sunday and a second storm Tuesday.

3d.task: Check you have three days of drinking water, about 1 gallon per person per day.

items.title: Pacifica Pier remains closed after part of it collapsed Wednesday
items.detail: KQED reported the pier's end fell into the ocean Wednesday. The pier has been closed since June under a local emergency. No new city notice found this morning.

ladder.summary: King tides continue; weak storm Sunday.

items.title: Coastal flooding continues along the California coast
items.detail: NWS has Coastal Flood Warnings in Orange and San Diego counties today and advisories around the Bay through Sunday. El Niño warm water is adding to the king tides.
items.action: If you plan coast or bayshore travel, check tide times and road status.

ladder.summary: Storm outages in the Northeast; new tariffs proposed.

items.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after Thanksgiving storms
items.detail: BBC reports Pennsylvania and neighbouring states are worst hit on Friday after storms on both coasts. Travel delays may continue.

items.title: US trade office proposes new tariffs on China, the EU and others
items.detail: The new levies would hit many large US trading partners; start is likely no earlier than January (BBC, AFP). No effect on shop prices yet.

ladder.summary: Zelensky presses the US on Russia; Spain votes soon.

items.title: Zelensky calls Trump's 'my friend' remark about Putin strange
items.detail: In a BBC interview Friday, Ukraine's president said the US is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks. The war and Russian strikes continue.
items.action: Nothing to do; watch for a stalled peace process.

ladder.summary: North Korea vows more nuclear weapons.

items.title: Kim Jong Un vows to build more nuclear weapons
items.detail: State media say Kim visited nuclear-material facilities after ignoring a US overture (NPR). No test reported.

ladder.summary: Gulf drone attack, Yemen strikes, Ebola.

items.title: Two Italians killed in drone attack on Kuwait; Iran denies it
items.detail: Italy and Kuwait say Iranian-made drones hit military sites Thursday; Iran calls it a false flag. Qatar reportedly warned the attack endangers talks.
items.action: If Gulf travel is planned, check State Department advisories.

items.title: Houthis report 11 killed in airstrike on a cinema in Taiz
items.detail: The Houthi health ministry blames Saudi Arabia; the claim is unverified. Saudi-Houthi fighting has continued since early November.

items.title: Ebola in eastern Congo reaches about 12,000 cases
items.detail: NPR reports the outbreak is spreading and fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting response; some responders left. No US case reported in these sources.
